id: title:danielcarletti:send help scout an oauth state it returns intact

review.posthog_relevance: Authentication and Identity preservation in OAuth flows for Help Scout and Linear, preventing loss of team_id or token parameters.
review.reason: The change adds OAuth state decoding and opaque-state configuration. P1.F3.H3 shows the backend URL construction now hex-encodes the state payload. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it prevents Help Scout and Linear OAuth providers from mangling or dropping the `state` parameter, which could otherwise result in failed authentication or loss of the `team_id`/`_
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation of the frontend decoding and the complete set of affected OAuth providers are not fully demonstrated in the provided hunk; the benefit relies on the backend change and an assumed corresponding frontend update. No test or release notes are provided to verify the fix prevents actual token loss.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds OAuth state decoding and opaque-state configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Backend OAuth authorize URL now hex-encodes state for providers that mangle it; frontend must decode before parsing. This prevents Help Scout and Linear from dropping the team_id or token. No score assigned.
